findings.configChangePath: For this Hyper-V (V6) deployment the host measures the LEDGER envelope's unresolved config (windows/node/host.mjs:1009, appConfig strictCid); the operator ENCLAVE_APP_CONFIG_PATCH (#patchConfig) is NOT applied on that path. So the only authorized change is the owner's `enclave config set` (cli/enclave.mjs cmdConfig: owner key; a session is refused for a wallet-held deployment) = an owner-signed setConfig TRANSACTION on Base. The config file holds only $NAME references; the relay-held secret values are not part of it and stay as they are.
findings.rebuildOnToggle: Provider::announce_root returns early only when current_root == root AND head is set; that state is loaded from /data/ipni-chain.json. This partition has no /data (live ipni.durable false, durableState false), so every relaunch starts empty and the first signed value builds a fresh ad. No state deletion is needed. A config change itself relaunches the app (startup race again).
